Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original Thiên Sơn skill CONCEPT REVIEW BOARD, Phase1 only; NOT a runtime animation sheet, NOT a VFX atlas and NOT an approved final icon.
Input1 is the EXACT APPROVED Thiên Sơn character concept, input2 is the APPROVED matching fan or curved-dao runtime atlas. Reuse visual identity precisely: handsome young male aristocrat, oversized chibi head ~40-45% body height, ~2.5heads tall, long dark topknot hair/jade-silver pin, ivory/paleblue ribbons, ivory layered silk martial robes, skyblue lining, jade sash/trim and wind-scroll cuffs/hem, restrained silver clasps, small dark blue-gray shoes. Same face, costume, fan and CURVED Chinese dao. Fan ALWAYS anatomicalRIGHT; dao sheathedLEFT in fan style. Dao style holds blade anatomicalRIGHT; fan closed on LEFT sash beside empty scabbard. No redesign, extra armor, hat, monk, female hero or swapped weapon hands.
Style: detailed crisp chibi wuxia PIXEL ART, deliberate sharp pixel clusters and stepped selective dark outlines, upper-left lighting. Stable slightly elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG OVERWORLD perspective in every action; top of head/shoulders visible plus face/body/feet. NO cinematic side-view, perspective chase, isometric diamonds, painterly blur, smooth vectors or 3D.
LAYOUT: high-quality wide landscape board, approximately1536x1024, muted pale parchment with generous whitespace and fine jade-gray separators. A small clear title at top: exact Vietnamese skill name plus ASCII ID, and small caption CONCEPT ONLY / PENDING APPROVAL. Upper two-thirds: three LARGE columns for ANTICIPATION / ACTION / RECOVERY. If action has sequential or conditional stages, show small clearly separated temporal sub-panels inside ACTION, not duplicate actors acting together. Every depicted hero full body, equal scale, feet readable, direction SCREEN RIGHT unless a short sideways evasive step or spin is the stated action. Arrows outside artwork may indicate motion, NEVER hitbox overlays/range numbers.
Lower band: left and center are isolated WIND-SHAPE/stage studies and one SMALL GAME-SCALE ILLUSTRATION of the same action on a simple square-aligned stone patch; the tiny hero roughly44 logical pixels tall. Vignette is a concept illustration, not a screenshot or measured hitbox. Do not enlarge character to make effects impressive. Show effect boundary, ground/foot anchor and direction; no arbitrary meters/damage/cooldown/time numbers.
BOTTOM-RIGHT: one isolated square ICON CONCEPT (approximately256px) with ample margin and label OUTSIDE the square. Icon uses deep INK-TEAL ground, crisp ivory/silver/jade silhouette, tiny pale-blue accents only; thin restrained jade inner rim and 10% internal padding, no heavy ornate outer frame (existing HUD supplies its frame). Clear large central silhouette readable when reduced to64/48/32px. Upper-left highlights. No words, letters, numerals, hotkeys, skill names or character portrait inside icon. Same coherent family across13 skills; distinguish by shape not just hue.
WIND, not ICE: thin directional jade-white air arcs, sparse open wisps, silk/ribbon flutter, controlled speed trails. No snowflakes, frost, icicles, ice shards, frozen ground, crystal spikes, lightning, summons or huge opaque glowing blobs. Face/feet/weapon and adjacent ground must stay visible. No invented teleportation, projectiles, CC, invulnerability, shields, extra reach, armor debuff or numerical rules. Stages are proposed choreography, not implemented mechanics.
SKILL: Liên Hoa Phiến / lien_hoa_phien. Style phien. Not an ultimate.
AUTHORITATIVE DEFINITION: Several rapid frontal fan hits; melee.
VISUAL PROPOSAL: Short layered fan-shaped wind crescents closely following the open fan across a shallow FRONTAL sector. Separate sequential sweeps, not a ring or ranged volley.
THREE KEY-POSE COLUMNS:
Anticipation: open fan drawn back across chest, compact planted stance.
Action: rapid fan slash with a few distinct shallow forward fan-edge echoes, feet planted, face and fan readable.
Recovery: right hand returns fan to guard, small local contact wisps fade.
RELEVANT STAGES: Near-hand activation wisp -> successive short frontal air arcs -> tiny close contact flicks -> clear fade; no detached projectiles.
ICON MOTIF: An ivory OPEN FAN with THREE short nested forward crescents; broad fan ribs remain dominant. Distinguish from single normal fan icon by the triple arc rhythm.
Keep the icon fully separated in the lower-right square, and do not let any labels cross its border.

SKILL Lục Dương Chưởng / luc_duong_chuong
AUTHORITATIVE DEFINITION: Moving spinning attack with repeated nearby damage.
PROPOSED CHOREOGRAPHY: Compact low broken wind ring around the feet/waist, following a turning hero and a short continuous ground path. Fan stays in the right hand. Open ring segments, never a tall tornado.
KEY POSES: Anticipation: knees bend, fan across body to wind up rotation. | Action: turn on a grounded foot, robe hem flares, open fan sweeps around a close broken wind ring; one intermediate turning pose visible as a small sequence inset. | Recovery: finish the turn facing forward, ring breaks into short curling wisps.
STAGES: Gather at fan -> close waist/foot spin moving with hero -> local contact swirls -> dissolve. Show nearby footprint; no pull, stun or stationary zone.
ICON: Low circular spiral seen from above with a tiny ivory fan tip and open center. A compact ROUND ring, distinct from the tall ultimate funnel.
This is NOT an ultimate. Keep the spin CLOSE and low with a continuous short ground trajectory, never the large ultimate funnel.

SKILL Lưu Phong Bộ / luu_phong_bo
DEFINITION: Short directional dash.
VISUAL: A short forward ground dash with parallel tapering air streaks trailing BEHIND the planted arrival pose, fluttering ribbons, one restrained translucent prior-position silhouette as temporal echo. No attack arcs or impacts.
POSES: Anticipation: lower weight toward front foot, fan carried at side. | Action: short forward step-dash to the right with one pale trailing temporal afterimage connected by air wisps; feet stay over the ground plane. | Recovery: regain upright guard with fan visible, trail thins behind heels.
STAGES: Lean -> continuous directional travel along short path -> settle/fade. No teleport portal, no slash, no contact hit, no invulnerability cue.
ICON: A small DARK SHOE/heel silhouette riding THREE parallel tapered horizontal wind streaks. A movement icon with NO blade or fan crescent.
Absolutely NO slash, target, damage spark or circular combat ring. Trail is behind heel, body moves along ground continuously. Keep dao sheathed.

SKILL Chiết Mai Thủ / chiet_mai_thu
DEFINITION: Temporary attack-speed and movement-speed buff.
VISUAL: A brief jade-white pulse at wrist and ankles, then TWO short restrained separate wrist/heel wisps. Tiny accents only; no full-body shield/bubble, no outgoing attack and no giant persistent aura.
POSES: Anticipation: fan held right, left hand forms a refined two-finger gesture near collar. | Activation: compact flash at right wrist and heels, ribbons lift slightly with a fresh breeze. | Sustained/recovery: return to relaxed fan guard with only two sparse short wrist/ankle wisps; also show feedback fading cleanly.
STAGES: Buff activation -> restrained temporary sustained feedback at wrists/heels -> clean expiration. No damage/target impact, no cooldown/cost/duration claims.
ICON: A refined TWO-FINGER HAND gesture framed by two rising wind commas/small speed ticks. No flower petals, frost, shield or clock text.
The sustained feedback MUST be MUCH SMALLER and sparser than attacks: two short wrist/heel wisps, face/robe entirely clear. Do not draw flower imagery despite the name. No defensive bubble.

SKILL Bách Phiến Phong Bạo / bach_phien_phong_bao
DEFINITION: Large moving fan whirlwind; ultimate.
VISUAL: A larger OPEN, low-to-mid-height WIND HELIX anchored on and moving WITH the hero. Ivory fan-leaf-shaped air ribbons suggest revolving fan edges. Hero's face/feet stay visible through the open center. Visually larger than close spin, not screen-filling.
POSES: Anticipation: fan raised outward in a deliberate wide grounded stance. | Action: broad layered broken wind helix wraps around hero at three-quarter ground angle, one clear open fan in hand; sweeping silk/air blades do not detach into missiles. | Recovery: helix unwraps into thinning ribbon ends and the hero settles to guard.
STAGES: Fan gather -> expanding open helix -> continuous moving whirlwind footprint -> local fade. No suction/pull/lift, projectile volley, launched tornado or extra movement distance/range claims.
ICON: A TALL OPEN SPIRAL/FUNNEL with clearly recognizable ivory folding-fan ribs along its lower rim, hollow center. Larger dynamic silhouette than compact Lục Dương ring.
ULTIMATE designation may appear beside title. Leave character face, open fan and both feet visible through gaps. Character body same scale in every column. Action larger wind footprint within column; open helix surrounding hero travels along a short continuous ground-path arrow. No launched tornado, hover, ice, summoned fans, projectiles or vacuum.

SKILL Phi Ảnh Trảm / phi_anh_tram
DEFINITION: Forward dash with a hard slash.
VISUAL: A single continuous forward body dash followed by ONE bold diagonal CLOSE blade crescent at arrival. Narrow trailing wind behind; contact flash tied to blade edge.
POSES: Anticipation: curved dao chambered behind the right shoulder, weight ready to travel forward. | Action: grounded rightward dash into one forceful close slash; one subtle trail marks prior position and a solid crescent stays ATTACHED to the blade reach. | Recovery: stop in a braced landing stance, blade low, trailing air expires.
STAGES: Windup -> offensive dash -> one close-contact slash -> recovery. No teleportation, ranged blade wave, stun, enlarged strike reach or additional hits.

Make attack a distinct SINGLE SHORT blade-attached diagonal impact at arrival, not a long detached shockwave. Show offensive travel vs heel-only Lưu Phong Bộ.
